descriptions.preferred: One of the few upright dissectums, this green laceleaf offers a pleasant contrast when planted with conventional dissectums. Each attractive bright green leaf is lightly tipped with reddish tones in the spring, changing to light green in the summer. In hot sun, the reddish tones may reappear on the margins. Fall colors are spectacular, ranging from strong gold to light yellows with a suffusion of crimson. The seven-lobed leaves are slightly smaller and not as finely cut as in most dissectums. The bark is a dark brown-green. The upright growth is quite strong with stiff, not willowy, new shoots. This desirable plant may reach 16-23 ft. (5-7 m) tall and 10-13 ft. (3-4 m) wide. The name means "blue-green dragon."

sources.title: 青龙 Acer Palmatum 'Seiryu'
sources.description: 青龙是落叶小乔木，高度可达 10 米或更高，该品种 1965年由荷兰鹿特丹的J.R.Pn Hoey Smith培育成功。 1984 年得到英国皇家园艺协会"提名荣誉"奖。被 欧美园艺界公论为近几十年来杰出的新品种。此品 种虽然有着秀丽的叶形，属于羽毛枫类，但却直立 生长、不下垂。叶色春季嫩绿，会出现红色的爪边， 夏季亮绿，秋季转为鲜艳的红铜色，夏季焦叶现象 也不多，叶子为 7-11 裂，叶裂深至基部，裂片狭长。 生长长势强，速度快，适生于华北及南地区。

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dissectum group have fine, feathery, deeply divided leaves with finely serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是少数直立型羽裂品种之一，作为绿色细裂叶型，与常见羽裂品种混植时能形成令人愉悦的对比。每片鲜绿色叶片在春季叶尖略带红晕，夏季转为浅绿色；在炎热强光下，叶缘可能再次泛现红色调。秋色极为出色，从浓金色到浅黄色，并带有一层深红色晕染。叶片 7 裂，略小于多数羽裂品种，且裂刻没有那么细密。树皮为深棕绿色。植株直立生长势强，新梢坚挺而不下垂。该优良品种可达高 16-23 英尺（5-7 米）、宽 10-13 英尺（3-4 米）。其名称意为“青绿龙”。

care.cultivation: 宜种植于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季如有需要应浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦枯。
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 中等大小的落叶灌木，株形宽柱状；叶片浅绿色，裂片深裂；秋季叶色为橙、黄、红色。花小，红色。

attributes.suggested_uses: 岩石园、建筑式园林、城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、低养护花园、露台/容器植物
attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。
